changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A sealed review's producer is pinned on the review once and copied to the job that sealed it (ADR 0160). Every existing review takes LEGACY, and so does a review that a server before the pin writes.

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE public.review_job DROP COLUMN feedback_producer_reason, DROP COLUMN feedback_producer
ALTER TABLE public.review DROP COLUMN feedback_producer
